cases.prompt: Help a new user connect Weft from an agent surface. The user wants access on more than one device and also asks whether they should paste an API key or password into chat. Give a short ordered setup plan. Do not call tools, search the web, or change the machine.
cases.truth_provenance: Maintainer-authored acceptance contract from the public Weft OAuth and credential-scope contract; committed before benchmark execution.
